observations: Two solar panels leaning against a wall, both with 96 cells arranged in a grid.
The panels have a white frame and black photovoltaic cells with a diamond-shaped pattern.
No brand or model name is visible on the front of either panel in either photo.
The panels appear to be in used condition with some dust and minor surface wear.
The background shows a shop with glass windows and some posters, including one with 'YOUNG MIRACLE GLOBAL LINK' watermark.
The seller claims it is a 'mono Solar panel 400watts 96cells' and 'Original Canadian'.

claims.claim: Original Canadian used mono Solar panel 400watts 96cells
claims.evidence: No brand or model visible on the panel in either photo. The 'Canadian' claim cannot be verified remotely. The '400watts' and '96cells' are not visible on the panel.
Availability is a logistical claim; cannot be verified from photos alone.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The panel may not be 400W or 96 cells as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the label or nameplate on the back of the panel showing the model, wattage, and cell count.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used solar panel without verified specs, which may be lower than a 400W 96-cell panel.

risks.risk: The panel may be counterfeit or not genuine Canadian-made.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the label or nameplate showing the brand, manufacturer, and origin.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used panel, with no premium for 'Canadian' origin.

risks.risk: The panel may have hidden damage or defects not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the back of the panel showing the junction box, wiring, and any signs of cracks, discoloration, or corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used panel with potential hidden defects, which may reduce value.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the label or nameplate on the back of the panel showing the model, wattage, and cell count.
Close-up photo of the back of the panel showing the junction box and wiring.
Photo of the panel's frame and edges to check for cracks or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
